primary_source.content: Oru Thooku Kaithiyin Vaakumoolam, a prison memoir by the death-row convict, has been selected for the Iyal Award, which is instituted by the Canada-based Tamil Literary Garden

sources.headline: From death row to award-winning author, C. Selvam expresses remorse, reflects on the families of his victims
sources.content: Oru Thooku Kaithiyin Vaakumoolam, a prison memoir by the death-row convict, has been selected for the Iyal Award, which is instituted by the Canada-based Tamil Literary Garden

brief_bullets: C. Selvam, a death-row convict, has achieved significant literary recognition after his prison memoir, 'Oru Thooku Kaithiyin Vaakumoolam,' was selected for the prestigious Iyal Award by the Canada-based Tamil Literary Garden. The memoir serves as a profound vehicle for Selvam to articulate his deep remorse and reflect on the irreparable harm caused to the families of his victims, marking a rare intersection between capital punishment and creative redemption. By documenting his internal transformation while awaiting execution, Selvam has sparked a complex public discourse regarding the nature of justice, the possibility of rehabilitation within the penal system, and the role of literature in humanizing those condemned by the state. This recognition underscores the power of narrative to bridge the divide between the incarcerated and society, forcing a broader examination of how we perceive individuals who have committed heinous crimes yet seek to reconcile with their past through intellectual and emotional labor. The recognition of Selvam’s work challenges the binary perception of death-row inmates, forcing a societal debate on whether creative expression can serve as a legitimate form of restorative justice or if it risks overshadowing the gravity of the original crimes.

stories.primary_headline: How to make the perfect poires belle Hélène – recipe | Felicity Cloake's How to make the perfect …

primary_source.headline: How to make the perfect poires belle Hélène – recipe | Felicity Cloake's How to make the perfect …
primary_source.content: Cool, juicy pears, cold ice-cream, hot chocolate sauce and a crunchy garnish – the perfect puddingIt’s always slightly embarrassing to realise that you’ve missed a pop culture reference, even if it’s 162 years old, so I won’t dwell on the fact that until last week I was unaware of the existence of Offenbach’s 1864 operetta about Helen of Troy, La Belle Hélène, after which today’s dish is named. In any case, the great French chef Escoffier was so moved by it, or perhaps by its popularity among Parisian diners, to name this simple dessert of vanilla-scented poached pears topped with hot chocolate sauce after the work’s heroine, played by the comely Hortense Schneider.Though other homages (he includes no fewer than five dishes with that name in his 1907 Guide Culinaire, none of which involve pears) may, like the music, have faded from public consciousness, this particular pairing, if you’ll forgive the pun, has stood the test of time. As Nigel Slater observes in Tender: Volume 2, “The marriage of pears and chocolate is extraordinary. It is as if they were made for each other.” This, I think, is the duo at its “most sumptuous”. Continue reading...

primary_source.headline: Durga Puja 2026: Inside Visakhapatnam’s oldest and biggest celebrations

sources.headline: Durga Puja 2026: Inside Visakhapatnam’s oldest and biggest celebrations
sources.content: From age-old traditions to the resounding dhaak, Visakhapatnam’s Bengali community comes together to celebrate Durga Puja with devotion, music and bhog

brief_bullets: As Visakhapatnam prepares for the 2026 Durga Puja festivities, the city’s vibrant Bengali community is gearing up to host its most elaborate celebrations to date, honoring a legacy that blends deep-rooted cultural traditions with modern communal spirit. Centered around the city’s oldest and largest pandals, the event serves as a focal point for thousands of devotees who gather to witness the rhythmic resonance of the traditional dhaak drums and participate in the sacred rituals of worship. Organizers have meticulously curated a schedule that emphasizes authentic cultural preservation, featuring elaborate idol craftsmanship and the communal distribution of bhog, which remains a cornerstone of the festival's social fabric. By bridging the gap between ancestral customs and the evolving urban landscape of Visakhapatnam, these celebrations reinforce the enduring influence of the Bengali diaspora in shaping the city's diverse religious and cultural identity while fostering significant inter-community engagement. The scale of these celebrations highlights the growing cultural and economic influence of the Bengali diaspora in coastal Andhra Pradesh, signaling a shift toward more robust, community-led public festivals that drive local tourism and social cohesion.

stories.primary_headline: Hilarious quips and ‘100,000-volt’ energy: the hypemen (and women) redefining Afrobeats music

primary_source.headline: Hilarious quips and ‘100,000-volt’ energy: the hypemen (and women) redefining Afrobeats music
primary_source.content: Style of emceeing based on high-octane, ad-libbed vocals has flourished thanks to its unique way of captivating crowdsFor the 2015 freshmen cohort of the history degree programme at the University of Lagos, their classmate’s first-semester presentation was so captivating that they began calling him Toby Shang, after the 16th-century Chinese dynasty he had focused on.His crowd engagement that day had been harnessed from his high school days as a ginger-man (energiser) in a three-man band and as a private tutor. By his final year at university, his viral catchphrases and infectious energy had resulted in a hit song, Shedibalabala. Today, he is one of the self-acclaimed “evangelists and pioneers” in the Afrobeats sub-genre some are now calling Afrohype or lamba. Continue reading...

primary_source.headline: Guwahati Airport Launches 'Utsav Aarambh' For Durga Puja
primary_source.content: The initiative marks the airport's first festive engagement at the arrival forecourt, bringing together Durga Puja-themed displays, traditional handicrafts, regional art, music and local food.

sources.headline: Guwahati Airport Launches 'Utsav Aarambh' For Durga Puja
sources.content: The initiative marks the airport's first festive engagement at the arrival forecourt, bringing together Durga Puja-themed displays, traditional handicrafts, regional art, music and local food.

brief_bullets: Guwahati’s Lokpriya Gopinath Bordoloi International Airport has officially inaugurated 'Utsav Aarambh,' a festive initiative designed to immerse arriving passengers in the cultural vibrancy of the Durga Puja season. This inaugural engagement transforms the airport’s arrival forecourt into a curated showcase of Assamese heritage, featuring intricate traditional handicrafts, regional artistic displays, and live musical performances. By integrating local culinary offerings and thematic decorations, the airport authority aims to elevate the passenger experience while celebrating the region's deep-rooted cultural identity during India's most significant festive period. This strategic move marks the first time the facility has utilized its transit space for such an extensive cultural activation, effectively positioning the airport as a gateway that reflects the spirit and traditions of Northeast India to both domestic and international travelers. This initiative shifts the airport from a purely functional transit hub to a cultural touchpoint, strengthening regional branding and enhancing passenger satisfaction through experiential engagement. It sets a new precedent for how infrastructure projects can leverage local heritage to foster community connection and boost regional tourism appeal.

It sets a new precedent for how infrastructure projects can leverage local heritage to foster community connection and boost regional tourism appeal.

primary_source.headline: James Cameron congratulates Marvel as Avengers: Endgame surpasses Avatar at box office

sources.headline: James Cameron congratulates Marvel as Avengers: Endgame surpasses Avatar at box office

brief_bullets: In a gesture of industry camaraderie, legendary filmmaker James Cameron publicly congratulated Marvel Studios and the team behind Avengers: Endgame after the superhero epic officially surpassed his 2009 blockbuster Avatar to become the highest-grossing film in cinematic history. Cameron shared a stylized image of an Iron Man-inspired Na'vi on social media, acknowledging the monumental achievement of the Marvel Cinematic Universe in capturing the global zeitgeist. This milestone marked the culmination of a decade-long narrative arc for the franchise, signaling a significant shift in the commercial dominance of serialized superhero storytelling. While Avatar had held the top spot for nearly ten years, the success of Endgame underscored the unprecedented power of fan engagement and the strategic expansion of the Disney-owned Marvel brand. This exchange between two of the industry's most influential creative forces highlights the mutual respect shared among filmmakers who operate at the pinnacle of global box office performance. This transition of the all-time box office crown validates the long-term viability of interconnected cinematic universes and reinforces Disney's unparalleled dominance in the modern theatrical landscape.

primary_source.headline: ‘I should have put my foot down’: Madhavan reveals the one Tamil film he regrets doing

sources.headline: ‘I should have put my foot down’: Madhavan reveals the one Tamil film he regrets doing

brief_bullets: Renowned Indian actor R. Madhavan recently offered a candid reflection on his prolific filmography, identifying a specific Tamil project that he deeply regrets undertaking during his earlier career. In a revealing interview, the actor admitted that he lacked the professional assertiveness at the time to decline the role, despite harboring significant reservations about the script and the production's direction. Madhavan expressed that he should have put his foot down, acknowledging that the experience served as a pivotal learning moment regarding the importance of creative agency and selective decision-making. This admission highlights the immense pressure actors face within the competitive Tamil film industry, where commercial demands often clash with artistic integrity. By publicly addressing this professional misstep, Madhavan underscores the evolution of his career from a compliant performer to a discerning artist who now prioritizes narrative quality and personal conviction over mere project volume. This revelation underscores the growing trend of established stars asserting greater creative control, signaling a shift in industry power dynamics where artistic autonomy is increasingly prioritized over studio-driven casting.

sources.headline: ED intercepts Punjabi film producer Grewal at Delhi airport; records statement - ThePrint
sources.content: ED intercepts Punjabi film producer Grewal at Delhi airport; records statement  ThePrint

brief_bullets: The Enforcement Directorate (ED) has intercepted prominent Punjabi film producer Grewal at Delhi’s Indira Gandhi International Airport as part of an ongoing investigation into financial irregularities. Federal investigators detained the producer while he was attempting to travel, subsequently recording his formal statement regarding his alleged involvement in money laundering activities linked to the regional entertainment industry. This development marks a significant escalation in the agency's broader crackdown on financial misconduct within the Punjabi film sector, which has recently come under intense regulatory scrutiny. By securing the producer's testimony, the ED aims to map out complex financial networks and potential illicit funding channels that have reportedly permeated high-budget film productions. The agency continues to analyze seized documents and digital evidence to determine the extent of the financial violations, signaling that further high-profile questioning and potential legal actions against other industry stakeholders are likely to follow in the coming weeks. This intervention signals a tightening regulatory grip on the Punjabi entertainment industry, potentially deterring illicit investment practices and forcing greater financial transparency across regional cinema production houses.
